description: Replace the one-liner Dashboard.jsx placeholder with a real, data-driven dashboard page. Depends on FEAT-001 (MUI removed, build passing). Independent of any new API work — uses only existing live endpoints.
steps: Read apps/web/src/pages/Customers.jsx and apps/web/src/pages/Subscriptions.jsx as the pattern reference before writing a single line. The Dashboard must follow their exact state management style.

Rewrite apps/web/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx entirely. Structure:

  Imports: useState, useEffect from react; Link from react-router-dom; api from ../lib/api; PageHeader from ../components/ui/PageHeader.jsx

  Org guard: read organizationId = localStorage.getItem('current_organization_id'). If missing after mount, render a llah-card prompt with a Link to /organizations.

  State: loading (bool, true), error (null|string), stats ({ activeSubscriptions:0, openInvoices:0, totalCustomers:0 }), recentInvoices ([]), recentCustomers ([])

  Data loading (called in useEffect when organizationId is truthy):
    Run Promise.all([
      api('/subscriptions?limit=1'),        // read meta or data length for count
      api('/invoices?status=OPEN&limit=1'), // open invoices count
      api('/customers?limit=1'),             // total customers count
      api('/invoices?limit=5&offset=0'),     // recent 5 invoices
      api('/customers?limit=5&offset=0')    // recent 5 customers
    ])
    From each response.data read: subscriptions total from response.data.total (customers endpoint returns { customers:[], total:N }), invoices returns array directly from response.data — use response.data.length or response.data.total if present.
    Set stats, recentInvoices, recentCustomers from results.

Render the page. Exact layout: If no org:

After writing Dashboard.jsx, verify the API response shapes by re-reading apps/api/src/modules/customers/router.js (returns { data: { customers:[], total:N } }) and apps/api/src/modules/invoices/router.js (returns { data: [] array }). Adjust array extraction accordingly: customers → response.data.customers, invoices → response.data (array directly).
router.jsx already imports and registers Dashboard at /dashboard — no changes needed there.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard.jsx uses import { api } from '../lib/api' (not useAuth().api)
Dashboard.jsx reads organizationId from localStorage.getItem('current_organization_id') and shows org-select prompt when missing
Four StatCard tiles render in a 2-column grid
Two data tables (recent invoices, recent customers) render in a 2-column grid below the stat cards
Revenue slot shows '—' with 'Coming soon' sub-label (no call to /revenue endpoint)
Amount displayed as (totalAmountMinor / 100).toFixed(2) — no floating point math stored
verification: Run: npm run build -w @llah/web — must exit 0 with no import/JSX errors
Run: npm run test -w @llah/web — existing tests must still pass
